measurement: GNU du --summarize --bytes; no symlink dereference; all calls exit 0; hardlinked storage counted once by du
scope: Measured shared project data/environments and reused native Conda base/cache; no old user environments. Not a reservation or atomic snapshot.
notes: Measured after VL dependency installation and before its final small inference output; later job deltas require owner preflight.
Source worktrees and historical test scratch are not included; no cache/partial/archive deletion.
Owner quotas continue to bound all concurrent writes. The library report runtime=70GB is a conservative allocation ceiling, not measured usage.
Original ZIP plus extracted files, retained partial downloads, wheels, weights, environments, database and exports are retained within the measured owner trees.
